title: IG-11
description: The IG series of Assassin Droids were largely outlawed in the galaxy and rare, but IG-II managed to find work with the Bounty Hunters Guild on the fringes of the Outer Rim. Programmed to strictly follow their protocols, he was a durable and reliable bounty hunter for any job. His programming would not allow him to be captured, and he had lethal contingencies planned for that eventuality.
